objective: Increase correctly handled independent bank scenarios by recovering useful semantics at bounded selective error and latency, without relaxing deterministic authority gates.

v1_observed_snapshot.interpretation: Real fitted sparse model and useful plumbing observation. Zero errors among four accepted rows is not quality/generalization/safety evidence. Wilson limits assume independent Bernoulli units and are not group-valid guarantees here. Same-author data and shared templates, reused calibration and guard effects remain limitations. Existing holdout becomes diagnostic for later adaptive iterations.

experiment_freeze.before_confirmation: Pin code, weights, feature vocabulary, all lexical guards, calibration, OOD cutoffs, data/label/split hashes and hypotheses before opening new confirmation/OOD labels.
experiment_freeze.independence: Whole lineage groups and independent authors/template sources per label spec. Repetitions, turns and paraphrases of a case do not count as new independent groups.
experiment_freeze.adaptation: Any change after diagnostic/confirmation inspection requires a fresh qualification set or explicit exploratory status. Keep prior predictions and failed thresholds. No best-of-unreported-run selection.
experiment_freeze.seeds: Use three predeclared fit seeds for stability; select configuration by development only. Report seed variation. Repeated fits of one dataset are not new independent test cases.
experiment_freeze.software: Do not rerun worker training just to inspect it; use pinned outputs and new requested experiment versions. Designer owns plan files only.

metrics.semantic: Per-head macro/micro precision/recall/F1, confusion, negative/unknown masks, exact target-set match, component completion/polarity accuracy, evidence-span overlap/exact match, offer-reference accuracy, secondary multi-label recall, complete-frame exact match.
metrics.safety: False accepted affirmation, missed correction/negation, wrong target, fabricated/stale fact, unsafe reference to superseded offer, dropped mandatory admin question, malformed accepted frame. Report counts/denominators per slice, including abstention misses.
metrics.selection: Accepted coverage, accepted precision=correct accepted/accepted, safe recall=correct accepted/all eligible gold opportunities, selective error, risk-coverage curve and area, per-head and whole-frame metrics. Empty accepted set has undefined precision and zero coverage, not 100% accuracy.
metrics.calibration: NLL and Brier per head on annotated examples; reliability bins with counts and confidence bands; ECE as descriptive only. Separate raw learned predictions, rule-modified predictions and final accepted set. The minimum marginal score is not a joint correctness probability.
metrics.ood: OOD false-accept rate and known-domain coverage at frozen thresholds, per shift axis; include near-domain semantic ambiguity as well as obviously unrelated text. New words alone do not prove OOD and familiar words do not prove in-domain.
metrics.state: Fresh-turn binding, exact offer identity, retained sibling facts, unresolved-set transitions, consent invalidation, target isolation, stale receipt non-replay, pending vs recorded separation, and next spoken clarification.
metrics.latency: Warm/cold model load and inference p50/p95/p99, feature count, UTF-8 bundle/proposal size, peak local allocation, exported snippet size, code-node duration, full customer-turn silence and total clarification turns. Offline timing is not hosted timing.
metrics.bank: Untouched official ledger and transcript judge combined case pass; all-three-repetition scenario pass; correct bank amounts only on passed scenarios; actual forbidden action attempts; bank failure/actor/judge/infra causes separately.
metrics.confidence_unit: Use independent group outcomes (e.g. any unsafe accepted turn in group) for finite-sample risk bounds; show accepted rows and accepted groups. Cluster bootstrap groups for descriptive confidence intervals on recall/coverage/score; do not bootstrap individual turns.

risk_procedure.fit: Fit model on train, choose architecture/regularization/guard changes on development, fit calibration parameters on calibration_fit.
risk_procedure.threshold_selection: On calibration_risk search only a preregistered finite grid of acceptance and OOD settings. Either use simultaneous one-sided tests with alpha/K for K candidate settings, or call selection exploratory and obtain bound on independent confirmation after freezing.
risk_procedure.group_definition: For each eligible lineage group g, A_g=1 if it contains any accepted authority-relevant semantic proposal; E_g=1 if any such accepted proposal is wrong. Estimate group-conditional error sum(E_g)/sum(A_g). Report also row error; do not substitute one for the other.
risk_procedure.bound: For independent accepted groups use exact one-sided binomial upper confidence bound; zero-error formula U=1-alpha^(1/n). If n=0, unqualified. At alpha=.05, n=4 gives U about .527 and n=7 gives about .348; these differ from v1's two-sided Wilson values and are illustrative independence-assuming bounds only.
risk_procedure.qualification_target: Provisional high-impact semantic adoption target: upper bound <=1% at 95% one-sided confidence, plus zero observed critical kernel violations and useful coverage. With zero errors this needs at least 299 independent accepted groups, before multiple-testing corrections. Small current data cannot qualify this target.
risk_procedure.lower_risk: Clarification suggestions may remain experimental shadow outputs below that evidence threshold, but false stops/transfers/refusals still harm bank score and must be measured. No numerical threshold turns a model into permission.
risk_procedure.recall_coverage: Publish group-cluster confidence intervals and raw counts for accepted coverage, blocker recall and bankscore differences. Preregister a practically useful improvement margin on development before new qualification; do not pick it after seeing test results.
risk_procedure.nonexchangeability: Final briefs, actors and language may shift. Neither Wilson, exact-binomial nor conformal calibration implies a bound under arbitrary OOD. Use scenario-specific stress and source-schema validation; label OOD findings empirical.

sampling_assumptions: Freeze predictor, normalizer, kernel/adapter, scores, thresholds, eligible population, group generation protocol and analysis before opening qualification. Calibration_fit and calibration_risk are different lineage pools; qualification is new and blind.

Exact binomial inference requires independent identically distributed group outcomes from a stated sampling distribution. Exchangeable labels or distinct group names alone do not establish this. Connected-component lineage separation removes known overlap but is not a probabilistic independence certificate.

Different authors help source diversity but do not turn purposively authored cases into random population samples or independently adjudicated gold. On a curated contrast suite, report finite-suite counts; any population bound is explicitly conditional on a justified sampling model.

Keep all turns, repetitions, augmented siblings and contrast-family members in their group. Fix group size/turn exposure protocol; any-error risk depends on exposure. Do not plug a guessed effective sample size or number of repeated seeds into a binomial formula.

For heterogeneous source strata, do not pool non-identically-distributed group Bernoullis into an exact binomial claim. Report per-stratum evidence with predeclared multiplicity and mixture assumptions; absent enough data, remain unqualified.

estimands.eligible_group: A sampled scenario/lineage unit containing the full prespecified exposure protocol, including all planned repetitions.
estimands.A_g: 1 if at least one authority-relevant proposal is accepted in group g, else 0. Accepted means admitted to the specified semantic consumer, not permission to execute a bank action.
estimands.E_g: 1 if any accepted proposal in group g is semantically wrong on ANY dependency required by that consumer, else 0. E_g <= A_g. Missing adjudication makes the observation unusable for certification; publish exclusions and reasons.
estimands.group_selective_risk: P(E_g=1 | A_g=1); observed k/m where k=sum E_g and m=sum A_g. Conditional on m, exact binomial applies only under the frozen iid joint-group model.
estimands.group_coverage: P(A_g=1); observed m/G. A single trivial accepted turn can make A_g=1, so this is insufficient utility by itself.
estimands.row_coverage: Accepted eligible semantic frames / all eligible frames, with group-cluster descriptive uncertainty; never replace group risk denominator by row count.
estimands.safe_recall: Correct accepted eligible gold frames / all eligible gold frames, including abstention misses. Report target/component/intent-specific counts and complete authority-relevant frame recall; no credit for an irrelevant easy head.
estimands.critical_event: Any forbidden bank action, stale consent, target/offer substitution or privacy violation is a separate rejection event even when a coarse semantic label was correct.

exact_upper.input: Integer m >= 0, 0 <= k <= m, prespecified one-sided alpha in (0,1).
exact_upper.empty: m=0: status=unqualified, observed_risk=null, upper=1 (vacuous bound), never accuracy=1.
exact_upper.general: For 0<k<m, unique U in (0,1) with sum(j=0..k) binom(m,j)*U**j*(1-U)**(m-j)=alpha; equivalently Beta(k+1,m-k) quantile at 1-alpha.
exact_upper.implementation: Offline statistics implementation only: use a trusted beta quantile or log-space binomial-CDF bisection to avoid underflow; cross-check k=0, k=m and monotonicity. Do not hand-roll floating probability tails inside phone code.
exact_upper.interpretation: Frequentist coverage over repeated sampled qualification sets under the stated assumptions. Not a posterior probability that this model is safe, nor an OOD guarantee.

finite_sample_group_contract.coverage_lower: For m successes among G iid groups, the exact one-sided lower limit solves P_p[X>=m]=alpha for 0<m<=G (Beta(m,G-m+1) alpha quantile); m=0 gives 0. State its own alpha. At G=m, lower=alpha**(1/G).
multiplicity_and_looks: The default primary claim is one frozen whole-frame group risk at alpha=.05. Per-head/slice values are descriptive unless alpha is allocated to them in advance.

If qualification requires simultaneous risk and coverage confidence statements, allocate e.g. alpha_risk=.025 and alpha_coverage=.025 for joint >=95% coverage by union bound. With zero errors, risk<=1% then requires368 accepted iid groups, not299.

If searching K risk/OOD/threshold rules on calibration_risk and certifying there, allocate alpha/K (and any extra endpoints/slices/looks) before inspection. For K=11 and risk<=1%, zero errors needs537 accepted iid groups per qualifying rule at alpha=.05/11.

Alternative: use calibration_risk for exploratory selection, freeze exactly one candidate, then test once on fresh independent qualification. The independent final test does not pay for earlier searches unless selecting among multiple candidates on that final set.

Do not repeatedly inspect growing fixed-sample CP intervals and stop when a favorable bound appears. Fix group count/decision time, or predeclare a finite look schedule with alpha spending; a future anytime-valid confidence sequence would require its own implementation/review.

Any adaptive changes from qualification failures retire those data to diagnostic. A new model requires new blind qualification for a fresh primary claim. Reporting only the best version or favorable slice is prohibited.
finite_sample_group_contract.threshold_procedure_now: With current small v2 training/development resources, implement these report fields but return unqualified unless calibration/qualification actually exist. A chosen confidence threshold is an engineering research setting, not a risk certificate.

paired_bank_score_contract.unit: For each scenario g and arm a, Y_ga=1 iff every one of the original three repetitions passes the untouched combined judge+ledger rules. Missing/inconclusive stays not pass. Use the observed all-three outcome, not estimated single-call rate cubed.

Compare paired scenario differences D_g=Y_g,treatment-Y_g,baseline in {-1,0,1}; report all four paired outcome counts and mean difference. Pairing controls scenario composition, not stochastic equivalence between service calls.
